data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: implementation-plan SKILL.md Step 4 + Step 6 HARD-GATE language is already present and strong (lines 790, 942-944); the LLM-behavioral drift recurs under post-compaction context pressure. Step 6 has a CONTEXT ANCHOR at line ~932 for sprint invocations; Step 4 lacks an equivalent. The orchestrator post-compaction completed Steps 3+5 and jumped to user presentation, skipping Step 4. Proposed fix: add a MANDATORY STEPS CONTINUATION anchor immediately after Step 5 Task Creation, stating that reaching this point does NOT authorize skipping Steps 4 or 6. Classification: MODERATE — small SKILL.md text addition. Not addressed in this P2 pass; leaving OPEN.
